summary:
ABANDONED – A Digital Archive of Humanity’s Forgotten Relics Beyond Earth

ABANDONED is an interactive educational website dedicated to preserving the forgotten history of human space exploration. It highlights spacecraft, satellites, probes, and other human-made objects left in space after completing their missions, losing communication, or being retired.

The website transforms space history into an immersive digital journey. Visitors begin with a cinematic introduction before exploring an interactive solar system map to discover forgotten space relics. Each object features its history, creators, launch details, scientific mission, discoveries, and current status, supported by interactive 3D models that visitors can rotate and explore.

To make learning engaging, ABANDONED also includes an educational quiz with unlockable achievements and an astronaut-themed photobooth.

Our project addresses NASA's challenge by highlighting forgotten space hardware, explaining its historical and scientific significance, and presenting its stories through interactive technology, visual storytelling, and educational experiences.

Our vision is to inspire curiosity about space exploration while preserving the achievements behind humanity's journey into the unknown.

Our message: They may have been abandoned in space, but they should never be forgotten in history.
details:
Project Details

1. How the Project Works

ABANDONED is an interactive educational website that allows visitors to explore forgotten space missions and discover the stories of spacecraft, satellites, and probes.

  • Cinematic Introduction: Introduces the project through animations, storytelling, and optional narration.
  • Interactive Solar System: Allows visitors to explore different celestial locations and discover space relics associated with them.
  • Space Relic Archive: Provides information about each spacecraft, including its history, mission, technology, discoveries, and current status.
  • 3D Models: Lets visitors rotate, zoom, and examine selected spacecraft through interactive 3D models.
  • Quiz and Achievement Badges: Tests visitors' knowledge and rewards correct answers with collectible badges.
  • Space Photobooth: Allows visitors to take astronaut-themed photographs with space relic overlays and download a combined photo strip.

2. Tools and Technologies Used

Our project uses modern web technologies to create an interactive and educational experience.

  • HTML5: Builds the website structure and organizes its content.
  • CSS3: Handles the visual design, animations, layouts, and responsive interface.
  • JavaScript: Powers interactive features, navigation, quizzes, storytelling, and other website functions.
  • Three.js: Creates interactive 3D environments and spacecraft models.
  • OrbitControls: Allows users to rotate and zoom around 3D objects.
  • GLTFLoader: Loads 3D spacecraft models into the website.
  • HTML Canvas API: Creates visual effects, achievement badges, and photo compositions.
  • Web Camera API: Provides camera access for the interactive photobooth.
  • Google Fonts: Uses Cinzel and Cormorant Garamond to create the website's cinematic typography.
  • ChatGPT, Claude, MetaAI: Build code and text

3. Our Goals and Objectives

Our main goal is to preserve the history of forgotten space exploration technology and make it interesting and accessible to everyone.

  • Preserve Space History: Highlight spacecraft and satellites whose missions have ended or become inactive.
  • Promote Scientific Learning: Help visitors understand space missions, spacecraft technology, and scientific discoveries.
  • Encourage Interactive Exploration: Make learning more engaging through 3D models, interactive maps, storytelling, and quizzes.
  • Improve Accessibility: Present complex space science information in a simple and understandable way.
  • Inspire Future Generations: Encourage young people to explore astronomy, science, engineering, and technology.
  • Connect History with Technology: Use modern web development tools to preserve and share humanity's achievements in space exploration.
